{{Quote|I'm Watcher One with Imperial Intelligence. Those men you fought served me.|Watcher One, to the Jedi Knight|<ref name="Catching" />}}
'''Gerrard''' was<ref name="Catching" /> a [[Gender/Legends|male]]<ref name="Jedipedia-NPCData" /> [[Human/Legends|Human]] who served as a [[Captain/Legends|captain]] in the [[Imperial Military (Sith Empire)|Imperial Military]] of the [[Sith Empire (Post–Great Hyperspace War)|reconstituted Sith Empire]] during the [[Cold War (Galactic Republic–Sith Empire)|Cold War]] with the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]]. A dark-skinned Human with [[Color/Legends|black]] [[Eye/Legends|eyes]] and black [[Hair/Legends|hair]] cut in a series of stripes, Gerrard was assigned to [[Watcher One]] of [[Imperial Intelligence (Sith Empire)|Imperial Intelligence]] in the search for the Republic [[Scientist/Legends|scientist]] [[Doctor/Legends|Doctor]] [[Nasan Godera]] on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Taris/Legends|Taris]]<ref name="Catching" /> in [[3643 BBY]].<ref name="Time" /> They carried a [[Blaster rifle/Legends|blaster rifle]] in combat and wore the standard [[Armor/Legends|armor]] for [[Imperial soldier]]s. However, Captain Gerrard and many of their colleagues were [[Death/Legends|killed]] on a [[Battle in the Brell Sediment laboratory|raid]] on [[Brell Sediment laboratory|one of Godera's research facilities]] when a [[Hero of Tython|young Jedi Knight]], who was also looking for Godera, encountered the Imperials in the subterranean [[Laboratory/Legends|laboratory]].<ref name="Catching" />

==Behind the scenes==
Gerrard appeared in the Jedi Knight mission "Catching Up With Watcher One" in ''[[Star Wars: The Old Republic]]'', a [[Star Wars video games|massively multiplayer online roleplaying video game]] released by [[BioWare]] in [[2011]], where he is an elite NPC in Doctor Godera's lab.<ref name="Catching" />
